name: Hy-Nomas (Tencent interactive video world model)
summary: Tencent Hunyuan's open-weights interactive video world model: generates controllable 720×1280 video at 24 fps in 8 steps from a prompt/image plus camera and action inputs. Ships a distilled DiT (FP32 and INT8), cinematic and robotics LoRAs, DCAE-V VAE, PixelUMM decoder (with FP8 variant) and inference code; runs on a single RTX 4090 with INT8 DiT + FP8 decoder + CPU offload. Official demo Space and a benchmark dataset are public.

access.notes: Ungated on Hugging Face. Full repo ~196 GB; pick only the variant you need. Text encoder Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct is pulled separately (its own license). Robotics LoRA trained on RealSource-World data.

procedure: Clone the inference code: https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy-Nomas (or use the Docker image hynomasoss/hynomasoss:cu130).
Download the weights you need from https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy-Nomas (e.g. huggingface-cli download tencent/Hy-Nomas --include 'DiT/distilled_int8/*').
For a single RTX 4090, use the INT8 DiT, FP8 PixelUMM decoder and CPU offload as described in the model card.
Or try it first in the official demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/tencent/hy-nomas

verdict.why: Big-lab interactive world model under Apache-2.0, ungated, with a consumer-GPU (single 4090) path and a free demo Space; 44k downloads. Heavy (~196 GB full) and released 2026-10-21; the in-window news is the official demo Space.
